title: Run event
description: Kernel-emitted lifecycle events for a specific run. Streamed over SSE to subscribers (browser via client SDK, admin UI, external observers). Distinct from the general Event type: RunEvents are always about a specific run, always emitted by the kernel, and are used by the run subscription API rather than the general subscription API. Schema-version 1.1.0 removes the eight kinds the stream never sent: `run.queued`, `run.tool-invoked`, `run.tool-result`, `run.model-token`, `run.artifact-produced`, `run.guardrail-violated`, `run.approval-requested` and `run.approval-completed`. A kind is listed when the stream sends it.

eventId.description: `<runId>:<sequence>`; monotonic within the run. Used as `Last-Event-Id` for SSE resumability.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence within the run: the journal entry's `sequence` (`JournalEntry.sequence` in `@kindgi/runtime`).

nodeId.description: For step-scoped events: the flow node id.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload: the journal entry's `payload` (`JournalEntry.payload` in `@kindgi/runtime`), when it has one.
